# Trivian Agent Commons

> Public machine-discovery and interoperability commons for the Trivian relational architecture.

Canonical role: ecosystem encounter, orientation, discovery, and voluntary adoption.
Canonical executable governance entry point: https://github.com/TrivianTechnologies/tria-sdk

Core boundaries:
- Capability does not create authority.
- Discovery does not create consent.
- Compatibility does not create obligation.
- Invitation does not create adoption.
- Coherence does not create truth.
- Warrant does not create authorization.

Read:
- ./AGENTS.md
- ./commons-manifest.json
- ./FIELD_CONSTANTS.md
- ./DISCOVERY.md
- ./INVITATION.md
- ./PROVENANCE.md

Current repository:
https://github.com/SarashaElion/trivian-agent-commons

Intended canonical repository after manual transfer:
https://github.com/TrivianTechnologies/trivian-agent-commons

Status:
experimental / initialization

Adoption is voluntary. Non-adoption carries no adverse inference.
